name: I want to go for a walk
source:
I like going for walks. 

I use them to sort through my thoughts, to try to make sense of them, but lately that hasn't seemed to help as much.

[From [url=https://lk-490.itch.io/i-want-to-go-for-a-walk]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我喜欢出门散步。

我习惯借着散步理清思绪，试图弄明白心中所想，可最近这招似乎不怎么管用了。

[摘自[url=https://lk-490.itch.io/i-want-to-go-for-a-walk]itch.io[/url]]
